events.notes: Short context had the lowest Fusion v2 point RMSE (0.300070), but tail MAE regressed 12.87% versus persistence. Three consecutive complete-rule failures close the context family.

Concatenation was the best constraint-respecting Fusion v2 screen: RMSE and tail MAE improved over persistence and coverage degradation stayed within the advancement tolerance. It does not meet the final 2% success threshold.
None of the three physics-token variants improved on the current balanced Fusion v2 candidate; the family is closed for this cycle.
Reconstruction and full multitask initialization did not improve the balanced Fusion v2 screen; three non-improvements close this pretraining recipe, while the implemented machinery remains valid.
The corrected 2.03M, 3.60M, and 5.60M parameter arms all trailed the current balanced Fusion v2 candidate; the capacity family is closed.

For identical point forecasts, raw learned Student-t scale had 74.58% mean primary coverage and lower CRPS than pooled conformal calibration at 70.80%; raw scale is frozen for robustness characterization.

All 24 arms completed. Horizon v1 remained slightly stronger (0.299778 primary RMSE) than balanced Fusion v2 (0.300825). The balanced candidate is frozen for required multi-fold, three-seed robustness evidence, not confirmation or promotion.
The full three-fold, three-seed custom and control matrix, unchanged gates, and confirmation eligibility rule were frozen before full-run metrics.
The complete 24-arm screen report compiled from LaTeX to a four-page PDF. All pages were rendered and visually inspected after correcting one long path and one category-label overlap.
The inspected screen PDF was uploaded to the existing private Strata Research program folder and verified by Drive metadata; sharing permissions were unchanged.

All 45 required clean identities completed at the frozen revision. One run made dirty by an external goal-file edit was retained as failure evidence, excluded before analysis, and replaced by a clean deterministic retry with identical primary RMSE.

Fusion v2 improved 4.07% over persistence with the same direction for seeds 17, 41, and 73, but was 1.26% worse than the stronger MLP control and materially regressed tail MAE. Coverage, CRPS, bias, and stability passed. Confirmation remains sealed and the model is not promotion-eligible.

The six-page LaTeX robustness report was compiled, rendered at 2x, visually inspected, logged as a finished MLflow evidence run, uploaded to the private Strata Research program folder, and verified as a 67,833-byte unshared PDF.
A four-arm paired Smooth L1 objective screen is frozen before its metrics. Architecture, data, probability head, sample caps, thresholds, and the already-reported robustness result remain unchanged.

No intervention reached the frozen 2% paired RMSE improvement. The 0.50 and 1.00 weights also failed the tail-regression condition. Three non-improvements close the explicit point-loss family without a rolling advance.

The three-page LaTeX point-loss report was compiled, rendered at 2x, visually inspected, logged as a finished MLflow evidence run, uploaded to the private Strata Research program folder, and verified as a 50,554-byte unshared PDF.
A four-arm 12k/30k/50k/all-62,263 training-sequence screen is frozen before metrics. It changes only deterministic within-fold sample density and explicitly does not claim broader temporal coverage.

All three denser sample caps slightly worsened primary RMSE. The 30k arm also failed tail, CRPS, and coverage gates; the full arm failed CRPS and coverage. Three non-improvements close this within-fold density family.

The three-page LaTeX data-scale report was compiled, rendered at 2x, visually inspected, logged as a finished MLflow evidence run, uploaded to the private Strata Research program folder, and verified as a 48,166-byte unshared PDF.

A paired exponent 0/0.25/0.50/1.00 screen is frozen before metrics. It changes only a fixed, interpretable power-law scale on the persistence residual and keeps model parameters, objective, data, and evidence gates unchanged.

No fixed horizon exponent reached the frozen 2% paired RMSE improvement. The 0.25 arm also failed tail; 1.00 materially worsened RMSE and CRPS. Three non-improvements close the fixed power-law residual-scaling family.

The three-page LaTeX residual-scaling report was compiled, rendered, visually inspected, logged as a finished MLflow evidence run, uploaded to the private program folder, and verified as a 52,360-byte unshared PDF.

A four-arm no-shortcut/history-linear/all-linear/all-MLP architecture screen is frozen before metrics. Every shortcut consumes only past context, starts with a zero final projection, retains the deep branch, and uses unchanged data, optimization, and evidence gates.

History-linear cleared the 2% RMSE threshold but failed tail and 70--90% coverage gates. All-linear missed the RMSE threshold and failed tail; all-MLP regressed RMSE, tail, and CRPS. Three constraint-respecting non-advances close this shortcut family.

The final four-page LaTeX shortcut report was compiled without overflow warnings, rendered at 2x, visually inspected, logged to the finished MLflow evidence run, uploaded to the private program folder, and verified as a 51,119-byte owner-only PDF.

A paired 3/6/9/12-epoch convergence screen is frozen before metrics. It changes only the optimization cap for the fixed 3,611,849-parameter history-linear shortcut architecture and retains the same baseline, data, objective, and evidence gates.

Nine epochs improved the frozen no-shortcut baseline by 4.07% while passing tail, CRPS, coverage, bias, provenance, artifact, and resource gates. The 12-epoch cap early-stopped at 11 epochs on the same best checkpoint; the frozen efficiency tie rule selects nine epochs for rolling robustness.

The final four-page LaTeX convergence report was compiled, rendered at 2x, visually inspected, logged to a finished MLflow evidence run, uploaded to the private program folder, and verified as a 50,740-byte owner-only PDF.

Nine fresh full-data runs of the exact selected 9-epoch history-linear shortcut are frozen across three chronological folds and seeds 17/41/73. The 45 unchanged control runs are reused only by their previously frozen exact IDs and paired endpoint identities.

Fusion v2.5 improved on persistence by 6.51%, MLP by 1.32%, LightGBM by 12.09%, and Fusion v2 by 2.54%; both paired bootstrap intervals were positive and all seeds agreed. It nevertheless failed the immutable 2% margin over MLP and tail-MAE conditions, so confirmation labels remain sealed and this family closes without promotion.

The final six-page LaTeX robustness report was compiled, rendered at 2x, visually inspected, logged to a finished MLflow evidence run, uploaded to the private program folder, and verified as a 73,274-byte owner-only PDF.

A paired 0/0.5/1/2 masked tail-Huber screen is frozen before metrics. The threshold is the 90th percentile of capped fold-training targets only; the fixed v2.5 architecture, nine-epoch cap, probability head, data roles, and full robustness gates remain unchanged.

No masked training-tail weight passed the frozen joint point/tail gate. Weight 2.0 improved primary RMSE by only 0.49%, below the 0.75% advancement threshold, while all three interventions worsened primary tail MAE by 7.5--17.3%. Three non-improvements close this tail-objective family without robustness or confirmation release.

The final four-page LaTeX tail-objective report was compiled without overflow warnings, rendered at 2x, visually inspected, logged to MLflow, uploaded to the private program folder, and verified as a 65,761-byte owner-only PDF.
